title: Scale invariance of the two-sided volume density bounds (Simon 3.4.3 (10)–(11))
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^{m+1}, F ⊆ E Borel, y ∈ E and c₂, ρ₂ ∈ ℝ such that L^{m+1}(F ∩ B_ρ(y)) ≥ c₂ρ^{m+1} and L^{m+1}(B_ρ(y) ∖ F) ≥ c₂ρ^{m+1} for every 0 < ρ < ρ₂ (left-hand sides compared with ENNReal.ofReal of the right-hand sides). Then for all s > 0 and r > 0 with rs < ρ₂: L^{m+1}(F_{y,r} ∩ B_s(0)) ≥ c₂s^{m+1} and L^{m+1}(B_s(0) ∖ F_{y,r}) ≥ c₂s^{m+1}, where F_{y,r} := {w : y + rw ∈ F}.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (c₂ ρ₂ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₂ → ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (F ∩ ball y ρ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (ball y ρ \ F)) → ∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → 0 < r → r * s < ρ₂ → ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * s ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume ((fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * s ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s \ (fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F)
